Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Neeta - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Suresh - 44 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Ishaan - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Vihaan: "Careful!"

[Vihaan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Vihaan (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan drinks a glass of water.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Vihaan: "Really?"

[Vihaan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Suresh stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Flower petals rain down on Vihaan.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Neeta: "What happened?"

[Vihaan lights a bonfire.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Vihaan stands by the road. Neeta and Suresh stand near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Vihaan: "That's easy."

[Vihaan gets into the car.]

Vihaan (softly): "Careful!"

[Vihaan gets on the bus.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Suresh (surprised): "I really enjoyed today."
